body:
Ok, first of all sorry for the bad grammer and I hope that you'll be able to understand me.
A few days ago friend gave me 4 tabs of 25C-NBOMe (1-1.5 mg each), I took 1 tab and put it under the tongue and waited 30 min (I took 40 mg of ritalin LA about 4 hours ago).
First effects of 'feeling light' kicked in (maybe placebo) and after 50 min visuals began: no colors whatsoever, thing started to move, keyboard letters started to bubble, my dog's face look very much human, there was rain outside and a saw it inside, trees started moving, I saw fire in the apartment opposite (very unlikely to be real). Stuff moved the simultaneously with the music on the background, stuff changing (for ex.: I was looking at a old photo of mine (6 years old) and me in the photo starting to grow up.)
After 3 hours effect started to get down, still some visuals.
And 3 hours later I went to bed (with almost no effects).
Day after, when I was 'ritalin free', I decided to take 1 more trip, I finished school, went to my house, eat a little, did my homework, and put 1 tab under the tongue for 30 min. Effect began within an hour, mild colors a little like rainbow colors and all in all the effect from last night.
Day after I woke up, took ritalin and my muscles began to vibrate (1-2 at a time)+(important info: once in a while my leg muscle was vibrating the same way) I was panicked but I looked it up online, it's called dystonia, the muscles that moved: neck (that move my head), eyes, leg, arms, belly, fingers.
1 week after: much better. Neck, belly and fingers are good.
Once in a while I feel my arm and leg muscles move (every 2 hours) it's very mild, eyes sometimes blinking twice (very fast).
I stopped taking ritalin because it increases the dystonic symptoms.
I read that symptoms can disappear after days, week, mounths and even years - all I can do its hope.
All in all nice drug, not even a bit worth it, I advice that people who take ritalin to be extra carefull, and young teens also.
Peace from Israel, Dan.
